subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the area around Sal Terrae

716700201.text: Uhhh... Yeah, something's definitely off here. Look at all that spooky smoke around the Ley Line deposit over there... Could that be where the monsters are coming from?

716700202.text: Looks like the Millelith have set up camp to deal with this. There are soldiers and fortifications everywhere!

716700205.text: Yeah! Let's fight side by side with the Millelith and send those monsters packing — just like old times! Then we can focus on what to do about that weird deposit.

716700206.text: Halt, you two! There's danger up ahead. I'll have to ask you to turn back.

716700207.text: #No, wait... I think I recognize you. Are you Sergeant {NICKNAME}?

716700208.text: Sergeant? What the heck? Have you been doing night shifts in the Millelith while Paimon's asleep?

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the Domain through the disturbance point

716701101.text: It looks like this wave is finally over. Things have finally settled down.

716701102.text: For now, at least. We haven't eliminated the root cause. It's only a matter of time before the next surge of activity.

716701103.text: Still... we've won ourselves some valuable down time. Let's take this time to get some proper rest, and then prepare for the next battle.

716701104.text: Yes, M'am! You don't have to tell us twice!

716701105.text: The best order is a rest order! We're gonna eat good, sleep good, and get our strength back! ...Uh, and then do some strategic thinking... stuff!
